Definition: from G1223 and G2233; to relate fully:--declare, shew, tell.
BiblicalUsage: To declare is to tell a thing fully, to rehearse it from beginning to end, and the word is used of the works of God. The demoniac declares what Jesus did for him, Peter declares how the Lord brought him out of prison, and Hebrews says time would fail to tell of all the saints.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe declaring is the duty of everyone God has helped. The demoniac could not be silent, the apostles could not stop telling, and the telling itself is the witness that spreads the gospel.
